overview.en:
Manage Pinecone vector indexes, upsert records, query data and search official documentation.

Retrieve relevant information from vector-backed data with an explicit search question. Keep the collection or index and returned source identifiers attached to the result.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
管理 Pinecone 向量索引、写入记录、查询数据并搜索官方文档。

围绕明确的检索问题从向量数据中查找相关信息，结果中保留集合或索引及返回来源的标识。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Find records relevant to this question in the selected collection or index.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 在选定集合或索引中查找与这个问题相关的记录。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize these search results and include their source identifiers.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 总结这些检索结果，并保留来源标识。

starterPrompts.en: Compare the retrieved evidence for these two related questions.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 比较这两个相关问题检索得到的依据。

descriptions.en: Use Pinecone in Ghast. Manage Pinecone vector indexes, upsert records, query data and search official documentation. 管理 Pinecone 向量索引、写入记录、查询数据并搜索官方文档。
